title: Listening Drill — Wetland boardwalk
description: Visitor briefing. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Wetland boardwalk
sections.transcript:
GUIDE: Welcome to our visit to the tidal wetland. Before we leave, make sure your name appears on the list I'm holding. If you can't see your name, speak to me privately rather than adding it yourself.

GUIDE: Our meeting point is the bus stop. The visit itself will last seventy-five minutes. You don't need to take anything heavy, but please bring a raincoat.

GUIDE: We'll finish at the bird hide. From there you can make your own way home. One last detail: the boardwalk can be slippery. If you're separated from the group, phone the number printed on your ticket rather than taking a shortcut.
